shared_elements: carved stone monument with rounded/tapering upper contour
low-relief incised decoration cut into the stone surface
repeated small linear/glyph-like incisions in a band near the top
justification: Both are upright stone monuments whose surfaces are covered with shallow incised relief, including a circular disc element and horizontal dividing bands with rows of small repeated marks near the top, and both taper toward a rounded summit. But A is a flat slab organised into strict stacked registers of small, finely cut seated figures and script, whereas B is a massive three-dimensional block whose carving forms a single coarse, weathered body-and-headdress image with no register system at all.
